newsitem.title: USA: Flir to buy Spectra-Physics AB unit.
newsitem.headline: Flir to buy Spectra-Physics AB unit.

text.p: FLIR Systems Inc on Monday said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Agema Infrared Systems AB, a wholly owned subsidiary of Spectra-Physics AB .
FLIR Systems said it will issue about 4.2 million shares of its common stock to Spectra-Physics in exchange for all of Stockholm-based Agema's outstanding shares.

FLIR said it expects to record a one-time, non-cash charge in the fourth quarter of this year related to the writeoff of in-process research and development, and certain costs related to the proposed transaction.
The transaction is expected to be completed by the end of 1997. FLIR said the merger, when complete, is expected to be accretive to earnings on a fully diluted basis beginning in 1998.
FLIR supplies thermal imaging systems to government users around the globe and is also a supplier of commercial thermal imaging systems in the United States.
Agema, with sales last year of about $48.0 million, supplies commercial thermal imaging systems.
